messages:
maya: I want a short data-governance checklist to include in the initiative doc for Optimize Toolkit (eval-triggered alerts + quant advisor). Can we land on concise rules for pilot?

ron: High level: (1) default redaction, (2) residency badge, (3) explicit opt-in for hosting prompt suites.

kate: Also: no raw customer data leaves VPC unless customer signs data-use and legal approves. Default: link to customer-hosted context; show token-level snippet only.

maya: Draft checklist: 
- DG1: All alert examples redacted by default (emails, phones, SSNs).
- DG2: Full context never transmitted without signed consent; UI links to customer storage.
- DG3: Profiling in-customer (VPC) option available; hosted profiling requires explicit opt-in and cost consent.
- DG4: Residency badge on every alert & advisor card.
- DG5: Audit log entry for every profiling run + user who approved it.

ron: Add retention policy: store redacted samples 90 days; full-context pointers only recorded, not cached.

legal: Confirmed: need customer signature for hosting prompt suites; provide template. Also require a short privacy blurb in the pilot opt-in flow.

illum-bot: scheduled reminder set for 2912420000: "Legal template + privacy blurb due" :alarm_clock:

maya: Ops note: implementable within pilot scope if we limit hosted profiling to explicit runs with cost confirmation and 500-sample cap. Ops will add a cost-estimate modal and audit hooks.

ops-bot: reminder set for 2912421000: "Ops to prototype cost-modal and audit hooks"

maya: I'll add this checklist to the initiative backing doc and call out these as non-negotiable pilot gates. Thanks.
